name: Linear's own MCP server
gain: The team's coding agent can read Linear directly. No gain measured.
how: claude mcp add --transport http linear-server https://mcp.linear.app/mcp
replaces: Copying from the dashboard by hand.
trade_offs: It holds access to your account, so scope the token.
install: claude mcp add --transport http linear-server https://mcp.linear.app/mcp

gain_model.formula: no money figure: developer time, unmeasured

test_recipe.what_to_compare: a developer tries it on one task

verify_rule: Whether the team keeps it installed after 30 days

change_recipe.how: claude mcp add --transport http linear-server https://mcp.linear.app/mcp
change_recipe.left_off: Never a pull request: a brief line
